request.style: English, female solo voice, ethereal and reverent, organ, strings, piano, harp, choral pads, majestic and awe-inspiring, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Oh the depth of the riches of God
His wisdom is beyond our sight
His knowledge is a hidden well
Infinite in the fading light
How unsearchable his judgments are
How untraceable his ways
We cannot map the hidden depths
Nor trace the end of days

[Chorus]
From him and through him and to him
All things are held in his hand
From him and through him and to him
Forever the glory stands
All things are his creation’s song
Glory to him forever
From him and through him and to him
The light that never tires

[Verse]
Who has known the mind of the Lord
Who has been his counselor
We have no answer to give him
No debt that needs return
Who has ever given to him
That he should be repaid
He needs nothing from our offering
His grace is free and paid

[Chorus]
From him and through him and to him
All things are held in his hand
From him and through him and to him
Forever the glory stands
All things are his creation’s song
Glory to him forever
From him and through him and to him
The light that never tires

[Bridge]
Unsearchable is his wisdom
Untraceable is his way
We bow before the mystery
The light that we cannot say
No mind can grasp the counselor
No hand can hold the source
We rest in the depth of riches
The heart of the universe

[Outro]
From him and through him and to him
To him be the glory forever
Amen
